title: Live replies · {name}
label: Send replies as Claude writes them
detail_on: The web gets each reply line by line, seconds sooner
detail_off: Replies show up once Claude saves them
footer: When on, the Claude Code sessions Persona starts on this computer send their replies while Claude writes them, so the web shows the text sooner (the phone apps will show it in a later version). The cost: in this computer's terminal, replies appear a few lines at a time instead of word by word. The hub keeps this switch, not ~/.claude/settings.json; with “Change all online machines” on above, the other online computers change too. A change applies to sessions started after it; a session that is already running changes once Claude restarts.
